comments.body:
@erimerturk this outdated requirements...
I simplified the task, see  https://github.com/yegor256/netbout/issues/600#issuecomment-106876950
- ~~we have to setup a redirection all incoming messages for @reply.netbout.com into `bouts@reply.netbout.com`~~
- we have to add header`Reply-To: <boat_id>@reply.netbout.com>` into an outgoing email. e.g `Reply-To: 35351@reply.netbout.com>`
- ~~netbout should monitor mailbox `bouts@reply.netbout.com`~~
- nebout recieve email with the header `To:<boat_id>@reply.netbout.com` looking for the alias by email and boat_id
- post the message as the author

so you have to
- add header `Reply-To` into an outgoing email 
- create an implementation for `EmCatch.Action` which should look for the alias by email and boat_id and post the message into the bout as the author
